subject: Commercial onramp: payment path, PO vs card & marketplace next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novapay.com>, David Chen <david.chen@novapay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial onramp: payment path, PO vs card & marketplace next steps

Hi Elena / David —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we can get NovaPay on a pilot fast: 

- What we heard: you want to start with a 6-week pilot for payment-fraud detection models, expect ~10k requests/day, and prefer predictable vendor billing on PO but procurement requires vendor onboarding and SOC 2 artifacts. You also asked about marketplace options to simplify billing.

- Action items we propose:
  1) Complete the attached procurement quickform so your finance team has the vendor data they need (attached).
  2) Tell us your preferred payment path: card for an immediate pilot while PO is processed, or wait for PO onboarding for the pilot.
  3) Decide whether you want Redwood via an AWS/GCP marketplace listing (we can walk through timelines) or direct invoicing.

Attachments: redwood_procurement_quickform.pdf (PDF)

Can you confirm who on your side owns vendor onboarding (name + email) and an approximate target date for PO issuance if you go that route? If helpful, we can accept card for the pilot while procurement works the PO path.

I’ll follow up early next week with a draft mutual action plan and a simple pricing table for the pilot.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novapay.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: David Chen <david.chen@novapay.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp: payment path, PO vs card & marketplace next steps

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement: 
- We generally prefer PO/net-30 for vendor relationships, but we can use a corporate card for an initial technical pilot if Redwood confirms month-to-month billing.
- Vendor onboarding is owned by me (Elena Ruiz) and our procurement lead is David (cc'd). I’ve attached our vendor intake form and a short list of internal requirements.

Questions for you: 
1) How long does Redwood typically stay in marketplace application queues? Is being in AWS Marketplace a prerequisite to consolidated billing?
2) Do you have a SOC 2 report and a sample invoice we can share with finance?

I’ve attached our NovaPay_vendor_info.docx with a few fields filled — I left the PO timeline blank until I confirm internal sequencing.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Vendor Onboarding Manager | NovaPay
elena@novapay.com

Attachment: NovaPay_vendor_info.docx (DOCX)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novapay.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 10:18:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp: payment path, PO vs card & marketplace next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the vendor intake doc. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Marketplace timing: our AWS Marketplace listing typically takes 4–6 weeks once paperwork is complete. It is not required for consolidated billing; many customers use direct invoicing + PO and later migrate to marketplace for convenience.
- SOC 2: attaching a short SOC 2 summary and we can provide the full report under an NDA if procurement needs it.
- Pilot billing options: we can accept a corporate card for the 6-week pilot (month-to-month pricing) while procurement completes PO onboarding for longer-term contracting. That keeps the pilot fast and avoids blocking the technical evaluation.

I’ve also attached a simple pricing spreadsheet to illustrate pilot tiering and an initial DocuSign link for our standard MSA (you don’t have to sign to start the pilot; it helps accelerate PO processing).

Attachments: commercial_pricing_table.xlsx (XLSX)
Related: https://www.docusign.com/link/ABC123-redwood

Let me know if procurement needs any specific invoice sample fields or a vendor code format — we can produce an invoice sample that matches your AP system.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Commercial | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: David Chen <david.chen@novapay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@novapay.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 16:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp: payment path, PO vs card & marketplace next steps

Hi all —

Forwarding a quick note from procurement: they want to see a SOC 2 attestation and one sample invoice showing vendor name, tax ID, line item breakdown, and total. That will cover what finance needs to open a vendor record.

If possible, could Redwood provide: 
- SOC 2 executive summary (or pointer to a secure location)
- PDF invoice sample named "invoice_sample.pdf"

We'd like to kick off weekly check-ins until vendor onboarding is complete — available windows: Mondays 10–11am PT or Thursdays 2–3pm PT.

Thanks,
David
David Chen
Procurement Lead | NovaPay
david.chen@novapay.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novapay.com>, David Chen <david.chen@novapay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly procurement pulse + immediate docs to unblock PO

Hi Elena / David —

Following up with the items to keep momentum: where is it stuck on your side? To unblock vendor onboarding we’ve attached the two requested docs and offered a concrete short path below.

Attachments included here: SOC2_summary_redwood.pdf, invoice_sample.pdf

Proposed immediate paths: 
- Fast path: start the pilot on a corporate card (month-to-month). Redwood will send a pilot invoice each month and we’ll provide AP-friendly invoice samples now. Pilot can begin within 48 hours of payment.
- PO path: Redwood will support your vendor record setup in parallel. Typical PO issuance timeline from customers who have all docs ready is 7–21 days. If procurement wants we can raise a minimal pilot PO template to speed approval.
- Marketplace: If NovaPay wants consolidated cloud marketplace billing, we can initiate marketplace onboarding. Note: marketplace listing is additive — it doesn’t block the pilot but adds ~4–6 weeks to list. We can share the marketplace checklist if you want to pursue this.

Next steps I suggest this week: 
1) Confirm whether to run the pilot on card (fast) or wait for PO.
2) If PO, confirm who will create the PR and a target PO number/date.
3) If you want the marketplace checklist, reply and I’ll share it + an estimated timeline.

If helpful, I can book the weekly sync for Monday 10:00am PT — tentative invite attached. 

Thanks —
Lauren
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
